item.title: US government shutdown extended: Senate votes blocked again; House to stay out of session next week
item.description: The US government shutdown entered its third day with no resolution as Republican and Democratic leaders remain deadlocked. Republicans insist on their short-term funding bill, while Democrats refuse without their input, citing public opinion blaming the GOP. Both parties' bills have failed, and the GOP needs five more Democratic votes to advance their proposal.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Nothing can undo the trauma’: Cassie Ventura responds to Diddy's 50-month sentence; lawyer says she will ‘continue healing’
item.description: Cassie Ventura welcomed Sean “Diddy” Combs’ 50-month prison sentence for prostitution charges, acknowledging the lasting trauma he inflicted. Ventura, fearing retaliation, had urged the judge to consider victims' experiences. Judge Subramanian condemned Combs' pattern of abuse, while Combs issued an apology for his actions, calling his domestic violence a heavy burden.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Manchester synagogue attack: Suspect on bail in rape case, influenced by Islamist ideology- Key points
item.description: A suspected terror attack outside a Manchester synagogue on Yom Kippur left two Jewish men dead and three injured. Police fatally shot assailant Jihad Al-Shamie, 35, a British national of Syrian descent, who was on bail for rape and possibly influenced by extreme Islamist ideology. Six others were arrested on terror charges.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Stop bombing Gaza': Trump to Israel as Hamas agrees to free hostages; urges peace
item.description: US President Donald Trump reacted to Hamas's announcement to release all Israeli hostages, stating the group seemed ready for "lasting peace." He urged Israel to halt Gaza bombing for safe release, following his ultimatum to Hamas for a peace deal by Sunday evening. Hamas agreed to his proposal, ready for talks on Trump's 20-point peace plan.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Sean Diddy Combs sentenced to more than 4 years in prison after he breaks down, tells mom, kids he's sorry
item.description: Sean “Diddy” Combs was sentenced to over four years in prison for prostitution charges, though acquitted of more serious sex-trafficking. Judge Arun Subramanian condemned his abuse, citing his power and resources. Diddy broke down in court, apologizing to his family and Cassie Ventura, attributing his “disgusting” actions to drug use and expressing deep remorse.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Gaza peace plan: Hamas agrees to release all Israeli hostages; nods for further talks
item.description: Hamas announced its agreement to release all Israeli hostages, alive or deceased, under US President Donald Trump’s Gaza proposal, following his ultimatum. Trump warned of "unprecedented consequences" if a peace deal wasn't reached by Sunday evening, promoting his 20-point plan for Middle East peace, which he claimed had broad regional support.

item.title: Inside Sidney Crosby and Kathy Leutner’s private love story that has lasted more than 15 years
item.description: Sidney Crosby and Kathy Leutner maintain a private relationship. Leutner began modeling in 2005, appearing in Sports Illustrated in 2011. She works with fashion brands. Crosby achieved significant hockey success. They met in 2008. Both built impressive careers. They prioritize privacy. Their bond thrives away from public attention.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: UAE-Europe travel alert: New Entry/Exit System (EES) launches October 2025; what travellers need to know
item.description: From 12 October 2025, the EU will launch its Entry/Exit System (EES), replacing passport stamps with biometric checks for non-EU travellers, including UAE citizens. The system records entry, exit, and identity data to improve border security and detect overstays. UAE travellers should allow extra time at borders, especially on first entry, as biometric data will be collected.

item.title: UAE: Dubai to roll out over 200 ultra-fast EV charging stations for taxis starting this year
item.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority and Dubai Taxi Company have signed a long-term contract to deploy 208 ultra-fast EV charging points across the emirate. This initiative, rolling out from late 2025, aims to accelerate taxi fleet electrification, significantly reduce carbon emissions, and enhance operational efficiency for drivers, supporting Dubai's green mobility goals.

item.title: UAE officially announces Ramadan 2026: Moon sighting confirms start on February 19
item.description: The UAE has officially confirmed Ramadan 2026 will commence on Thursday, February 19, following successful moon sighting. Fasting hours will gradually increase, and temperatures are expected to rise from 16-28°C to 19-32°C, with potential rainfall. The holy month promises spiritual reflection and community celebration.
